title: Prediction: The long and the short of it
Confirmation bias and signaling in Downsian elections
Nondogmatic social discounting
Discounting by committee
Time consistency and time invariance in collective intertemporal choice
abstract: Recent work on collective intertemporal choice suggests that non-dictatorial social preferences are generically time inconsistent. We argue that this claim conflates time consistency with two distinct properties of preferences: stationarity and time invariance. While time invariance and stationarity together imply time consistency, the converse does not hold. Although non-dictatorial social preferences cannot be stationary, they may be time consistent if time invariance is abandoned. If individuals are discounted utilitarians, revealed preference provides no guidance on whether social preferences should be time consistent or time invariant. Nevertheless, we argue that time invariant social preferences are often normatively and descriptively problematic.

title: Uncertainty and decision-making in environmental economics: conceptual issues
Beliefs, politics, and environmental policy
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Experts and the general public often perceive environmental problems differently. Moreover, regulatory responses to environmental issues often do not coincide with consensus expert recommendations. These two facts are mutually consistent—it is unlikely that regulations based on factual claims that are substantially different from voters’ opinions would be politically feasible. Given that the public’s beliefs constrain policy choices, it is vital to understand how beliefs are formed, whether they will be biased, and how the inevitable heterogeneity in people’s beliefs filters through the political system to affect policy. We review recent theoretical and empirical work on individual inference, social learning, and the supply of information by the media and identify the potential for biased beliefs to arise. We then examine the interaction between beliefs and politics: can national elections and legislative votes be expected to result in unbiased collective decisions, do heterogeneous beliefs induce strategic political actors to alter their policy choices, and how do experts and lobby groups affect the information available to policymakers? We conclude by suggesting that the relationship between beliefs and policy choices is a relatively neglected aspect of the theory of environmental regulation, and a fruitful area for further research.
abstract_zh: 专家与公众对环境问题的认识往往存在差异。此外，针对环境问题的监管应对，常常与专家的共识性建议不一致。这两个事实是相互一致的：基于与选民看法相去甚远的事实主张而制定的监管，在政治上不太可能可行。鉴于公众的信念会约束政策选择，理解信念是如何形成的、它们是否会产生偏差，以及不可避免的信念异质性如何通过政治体系传导并影响政策，就显得至关重要。我们回顾了关于个体推断、社会学习以及媒体信息供给的最新理论与实证研究，并指出信念偏差可能产生的途径。随后，我们考察了信念与政治之间的互动：国家选举和立法投票能否被期望产生无偏的集体决策；异质性信念是否会促使具有战略意识的政治行动者改变其政策选择；以及专家和游说团体如何影响政策制定者可获得的信息。最后，我们指出，信念与政策选择之间的关系是环境监管理论中相对被忽视的一个方面，也是值得进一步研究的富有成果的领域。

title: Model confirmation in climate economics
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Benefit–cost integrated assessment models (BC-IAMs) combine climate science, impacts studies, and representations of long-run economic growth to estimate the costs and benefits of climate policy. They provide valuable qualitative insights into how policy outcomes might depend on ethical and empirical assumptions. Increasingly, however, BC-IAMs are being used to inform quantitative policy choices, despite their economic components being largely untested, or untestable, over relevant time scales. We demonstrate the potential benefits of model confirmation exercises for policy applications, demonstrating that the economic growth model used by a prominent BC-IAM had little predictive power over the 20th century. Insofar as possible, out-of-sample empirical tests of the economic components of BC-IAMs should inform their future development for real-world applications.
abstract_zh: 效益—成本综合评估模型（BC-IAMs）将气候科学、影响研究以及长期经济增长的表征结合起来，以估算气候政策的成本与收益。它们为政策结果如何依赖伦理和经验假设提供了有价值的定性洞见。然而，BC-IAMs 越来越多地被用于为定量政策选择提供依据，尽管其经济学组成部分在相关时间尺度上大多未经检验，甚至无法检验。我们展示了模型确认（model confirmation）练习对政策应用的潜在益处，证明了一个著名BC-IAM所使用的经济增长模型在20世纪的预测能力很弱。在可能的范围内，对BC-IAMs经济组成部分进行样本外实证检验，应为其在现实应用中的未来发展提供参考。

title: Adaptation to climate change and economic growth in developing countries
abstract: Developing countries are vulnerable to the adverse effects of climate change, yet there is disagreement about what they should do to protect themselves from anticipated damages. In particular, it is unclear what the optimal balance is between investments in traditional productive capital (which increases output but is vulnerable to climate change), and investments in adaptive capital (which is unproductive in the absence of climate change but ‘climate-proofs’ vulnerable capital). We develop a model of investment in adaptive and productive capital stocks, and show that while it is unlikely that the optimal strategy involves no adaptation, the scale and composition of optimal investments depends on empirical context. Application of our model to sub-Saharan Africa suggests, however, that in most contingencies it will be optimal to grow the adaptive sector more rapidly than the vulnerable sector over the coming decades, although it never exceeds 1 per cent of the economy. Our sensitivity analysis goes well beyond the existing literature in evaluating the robustness of this finding.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家易受气候变化不利影响，但对于它们应如何保护自身免受预期损失，目前仍存在分歧。特别是，在传统生产性资本投资（会提高产出，但易受气候变化影响）与适应性资本投资（在没有气候变化的情况下不具生产性，但能使脆弱资本“气候化”，即增强其抗气候能力）之间，最优的平衡点尚不明确。我们构建了一个适应性资本与生产性资本存量投资的模型，并表明：虽然最优策略不太可能完全不进行适应，但最优投资的规模与构成取决于具体的经验情境。将该模型应用于撒哈拉以南非洲的结果表明，在大多数情形下，在未来几十年中，适应性部门的增长速度最好快于脆弱部门，尽管其规模在任何情况下都不会超过经济总量的1%。我们的敏感性分析远远超出了现有文献，以评估这一发现的稳健性。

title: Agreeing to disagree on climate policy
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
The social cost of carbon—the cost to society of an additional ton of CO
2
emissions—is a crucial measure of the desirable intensity of climate policy. The models economists use to calculate it, however, are highly sensitive to the choice of discount rate, which measures our concern for the well-being of future generations. Different economists favor different values, and this leads to radically different policy prescriptions. We present a method for combining a diverse set of discount rates into a single “representative” rate and apply it to the analysis of the social cost of carbon performed by the US government. This approach may help resolve ethical conflicts and, hence, lead to consensus policy recommendations.
abstract_zh: 碳的社会成本（即社会每多排放一吨二氧化碳所承担的成本）是衡量气候政策适当强度的关键指标。然而，经济学家用于计算该指标的模型对贴现率的选择高度敏感，而贴现率衡量的是我们对后代福祉的关切程度。不同经济学家偏好不同的数值，这导致了截然不同的政策主张。我们提出了一种方法，将一组多样化的贴现率合并为单一的“代表性”贴现率，并将其应用于美国政府对碳的社会成本所进行的分析。这一方法可能有助于化解伦理冲突，从而形成具有共识的政策建议。

title: Climate engineering reconsidered
Policy distortions due to heterogeneous beliefs: Some speculative consequences for environmental policy
venue: Political Economy and Instruments of Environmental Politics
abstract: Many environmental problems are long run in nature. Consider, for example, pollutants that accumulate in the atmosphere, biodiversity conservation programs, and the use of pesticides in commercial agriculture. In each of these cases policy interventions are designed to regulate activities that yield short run benefits, but that impose uncertain long-run environmental costs on society. The temporal disconnect between the realization of these benefits and costs is often much longer than a standard political cycle in democracies, and is usually on the order of decades. Thus successful management of these issues requires actions to be taken by successive governments, most likely formed by several different political parties. The policies incumbent parties choose to address these long-run issues are thus strongly influenced by their awareness that in the future someone else may hold the reins of power.
abstract_zh: 许多环境问题本质上是长期性的。例如，在大气中累积的污染物、生物多样性保护项目，以及商业农业中杀虫剂的使用。在上述每一种情况下，政策干预都旨在规范那些能带来短期收益、却会给社会带来不确定长期环境成本的活动。这些收益与成本实现之间的时间错位通常远超民主制度中的标准政治周期，往往以十年为单位计算。因此，要成功管理这些问题，需要由相继执政的政府采取行动，而这些政府很可能由不同的政党组成。在位政党为应对这些长期问题所选择的政策，因此会深受其意识影响：未来可能会由其他人掌握权力。

title: Policy experimentation, political competition, and heterogeneous beliefs
Uncertainty and decision making in climate change economics
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Uncertainty is intrinsic to climate change: we know that the climate is changing, but not precisely how fast or in what ways. Nor do we understand fully the social and economic consequences of these changes, or the options that will be available for reducing climate change. Furthermore the uncertainty about these issues is not readily quantified and expressed in probabilistic terms: we are facing deep uncertainty or ambiguity rather than risk in the classical sense, rendering the classical expected utility framework of limited value. We review the sources of uncertainty about all aspects of climate change and resolve these into various components, commenting on their relative importance. Then we review decision-making frameworks that are appropriate in the absence of quantitative probabilistic information, including non-probabilistic approaches and those based on multiple priors, and discuss their application in climate change economics.
abstract_zh: 不确定性是气候变化固有的特征：我们知道气候正在变化，但并不清楚变化的确切速度或方式。我们也未能充分理解这些变化的社会和经济后果，或未来可用于减缓气候变化的各种选项。此外，关于这些问题的不确定性并不容易被量化并以概率形式表达：我们面对的是深度不确定性或模糊性，而非经典意义上的风险，这使得经典的期望效用框架价值有限。我们回顾了关于气候变化各个方面不确定性的来源，并将其归纳为若干组成部分，同时对其相对重要性进行了评述。随后，我们回顾了在缺乏定量概率信息时适用的决策框架，包括非概率方法和基于多重先验的方法，并讨论了它们在气候变化经济学中的应用。

title: Do probabilistic expert elicitations capture scientists' uncertainty about climate change?
On welfare frameworks and catastrophic climate risks
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Recent theoretical work in the economics of climate change has suggested that climate policy is highly sensitive to 'fat-tailed' risks of catastrophic outcomes (Weitzman, 2009). Such risks are suggested to be an inevitable consequence of scientific uncertainty about the effects of increased greenhouse gas concentrations on climate. Criticisms of this controversial result fall into three categories: The first suggests it may be irrelevant to cost benefit analysis of climate policy, the second challenges the fat-tails assumption, and the third questions the behaviour of the utility function assumed in the result. This paper analyses these critiques, and suggests that those in the first two categories have formal validity, but that they apply only to the restricted setup of the original result, which may be extended to address their concerns. They are thus ultimately unconvincing. Critiques in the third category are shown to be robust, however they open up new ethical and empirical challenges for climate economics that have thus far been neglected – how should we ‘value’ catastrophes as a society? I demonstrate that applying results from social choice to this problem can lead to counterintuitive results, in which society values catastrophes as infinitely bad, even though each individual’s utility function is bounded. Finally, I suggest that the welfare functions traditionally used in climate economics are ill-equipped to deal with climate catastrophes in which population size changes. I propose an alternative welfare framework with normatively desirable properties, which has the effect of dampening the contribution of catastrophes to welfare.
abstract_zh: 气候变化经济学中近期的理论研究表明，气候政策对灾难性结果的“肥尾”风险高度敏感（Weitzman, 2009）。有观点认为，此类风险是关于温室气体浓度增加对气候影响的科学不确定性所不可避免的结果。针对这一有争议结论的批评可分为三类：第一类认为它可能与气候政策的成本效益分析无关；第二类质疑肥尾假设；第三类质疑原结论所假设的效用函数的表现。本文分析了这些批评，并认为前两类批评具有形式上的有效性，但它们仅适用于原结论的限定设定，而该设定可以被扩展以回应这些关切。因此，这些批评最终并不具有说服力。第三类批评则被证明是稳健的，但它们开启了气候经济学中迄今被忽视的新的伦理和经验挑战：社会应当如何对灾难进行“估值”？我证明，将社会选择理论的结果应用于这一问题，可能得出反直觉的结论：社会可能将灾难视为无限糟糕，尽管每个人的效用函数是有界的。最后，我认为，气候经济学中传统使用的福利函数在应对人口规模发生变化的气候灾难时能力不足。我提出了一个具有规范合意性质的替代性福利框架，其效果是抑制灾难对福利的贡献。

title: Scientific ambiguity and climate policy
Climate prediction for adaptation: Who needs what?
abstract: The role of short- and long-term climate predictions in determining the success of adaptation to climate change is investigated. A simple theoretical model that captures the relationship between adaptive performance, decision structure, and prediction accuracy at different temporal scales is developed, and its implications deduced. It is shown that users who face high adjustment costs (i.e. are inflexible) depend more heavily on accurate long-term predictions than those who are able to adjust their adaptation strategies at low cost. However, the constraints on the accuracy of long-term predictions in order for them to be `accurate enough' to be recommended unreservedly are strongest for precisely those users who desire them most. There are thus intrinsic structural limitations to the utility of long-term predictions for adaptive decision making. In addition, the heterogeneous dependence of adaptive performance on predictions at different temporal scales gives rise to a resource allocation problem for investments aimed at improving predictions so as to maximize their social benefits. It is suggested that an explicit distributional framework that matches users' needs with scientific feasibility is needed in order to guide such investments, and key issues any such framework will need to address are discussed.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了短期和长期气候预测在决定气候变化适应成功与否中的作用。我们构建了一个简单的理论模型，刻画了适应绩效、决策结构与不同时间尺度预测精度之间的关系，并推导出其含义。结果表明，调整成本高（即缺乏灵活性）的使用者，比那些能够以低成本调整适应策略的使用者更依赖准确的长期预测。然而，长期预测要达到“足够准确”、从而可以无保留推荐的精度约束，恰恰对最渴望获得这些预测的使用者最为严格。因此，长期预测在适应性决策中的效用存在内在的结构性局限。此外，适应绩效对不同时间尺度预测的异质性依赖，使得改进预测的投资产生了资源配置问题，以实现其社会效益最大化。有观点认为，需要一个明确的分布性框架，将使用者的需求与科学可行性相匹配，以指导此类投资；本文讨论了任何此类框架都需要处理的关键问题。
